og.alt: RX: items().sort() just mutated your state. sortBy does not. 1 reactive node for a three-stage pipe, where separate calls build three

hero.alt: Schematic: a products signal in its original order flows through pipe(filter in stock, sortBy price, take 3), which is one reactive node. Adding a plant pot to products recomputes the pipe once and the top three become Plant pot, Desk lamp and Monitor arm. The source list keeps its order; nothing is sorted in place.
